fact: UNESCO says the higher-education ministry (MESRSFP) trained its statistics and digitalisation staff on 20-25 July 2026 on the StatEduc application, as part of modernising Chad's education information management system (SIGE), under the GPE-financed PRET.

UNESCO says it handed over on 15 June 2026 about USD 550,000 of GPE-financed computing equipment to education ministry bodies, aimed at modernising and decentralising Chad's education information management system (SIGE).
UNICEF Innocenti says Chad's EMIS has routinely collected data from schools since 2009, analysed centrally with a statistical yearbook produced annually.
UNICEF Innocenti says decentralisation of the EMIS is already effective in 16 provinces and is to be extended to seven others under the PRET.
